result.summary: Adds missing header declarations and marks translation-unit-local functions as static across several subsystems, including REST, Qt, RPC, and test utilities. It removes unused header forward declarations and ensures internal functions have internal linkage.
result.problem: Functions defined without prior declarations or with mismatched local declarations prevent the codebase from enabling compiler warning flags like -Wmissing-declarations and -Wmissing-prototypes.
evidence: PR description: 'Some more changes split out of #36743.' (#36743 is '[RFC] build: build with -Wmissing-declarations/prototypes').
Commit 36763783e9 notes that ForceActivation was previously declared locally in guiutil.cpp, so the definition was never checked against the declaration.
result.scope_notes: Touches multiple subsystems (REST, Qt, RPC, tests) purely to adjust function linkage and header declarations.
result.card: Adds missing header declarations and marks translation-unit-local functions static across REST, Qt, RPC, and test helpers. This addresses undeclared functions and mismatched local prototypes to prepare the codebase for enabling -Wmissing-declarations and -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warnings. It unblocks PR #36743.
uncertainties: The patch and file list were not provided, so the full list of affected functions cannot be verified directly.

risk.why: Mistakes in function linkage or missing declarations would cause build-time compilation or linking failures rather than runtime regressions.
